profileSlots.name: shaft
profileSlots.description: Vertical half-profile of the column shaft. x ≥ 0 (revolved around Y axis). Encodes fluting, taper, entasis.

profileSlots.name: base
profileSlots.description: Half-profile of the column base (plinth + torus + scotia). x ≥ 0.

profileSlots.name: capital_bottom
profileSlots.description: Top-of-shaft cross-section (closed polygon). Usually circular for round shafts.

profileSlots.name: capital_top
profileSlots.description: Under-abacus cross-section (closed polygon). Usually wider than capital_bottom.
